meta.title: 博物馆别只拍文物！6个拍照口诀拍出故事感
meta.title_en: Don't Just Shoot Relics! 6 Photo Rhymes for Museum Story Feel
meta.topic: 摄影教学 · 构图口诀

scenes.title_cn: 拍一个用特写，拍两个用对角线
scenes.context: 博物馆拍照口诀。拍一个文物用特写，放大细节；拍两个用对角线构图，画面有呼应。语域：摄影教学，口诀式极简。
sentences: 拍一个，用特写，放大细节。
Shoot one subject with a close-up, magnifying the detail.
magnifying the detail（放大细节）
拍两个，对角线构图。
Shoot two with a diagonal composition.
diagonal composition（对角线构图）
画面有呼应，故事感就出来了。
The two elements echo each other, and the story feel emerges.
echo each other（互相呼应）
paraphrase: 对角线构图 → diagonal composition / diagonal framing
scenes.speak: Shoot one subject with a close-up, magnifying the detail. Shoot two with a diagonal composition. The two elements echo each other, and the story feel emerges.

scenes.title_cn: 拍多个绕侧面，故事感用剪影
scenes.title_en: Many: Circle to the Side; Story: Silhouette
scenes.context: 拍多个文物就绕到侧面，用斜角度拍出纵深；想要故事感就用剪影，逆光突出轮廓。语域：摄影教学，口诀式。
sentences: 拍多个，绕侧面，斜角度纵深。
Shoot several by circling to the side for oblique depth.
oblique depth（斜角度纵深）
故事感，用剪影。
For story feel, use a silhouette.
a silhouette（剪影）
逆光下轮廓更突出。
Backlight makes the outline stand out.
the outline stands out（轮廓突出）
paraphrase: 斜角度纵深 → oblique depth / angled perspective
scenes.speak: Shoot several by circling to the side for oblique depth. For story feel, use a silhouette. Backlight makes the outline stand out.

scenes.title_cn: 窗影找反射，层次用框架
scenes.title_en: Window Shadows: Seek Reflections; Layers: Use Frames
scenes.context: 拍窗影要找反射，虚实结合；拍层次就用框架构图，门洞、窗框都是天然画框。语域：摄影教学，口诀式。
sentences: 拍窗影，找反射，虚实结合。
For window shadows, seek reflections — blend sharp and soft.
blend sharp and soft（虚实结合）
拍层次，用框架构图。
For layering, use framing composition.
framing composition（框架构图）
门洞窗框，都是天然画框。
Doorways and window frames are natural picture frames.
natural picture frames（天然画框）
paraphrase: 虚实结合 → blend sharp and soft / mix focus and blur
sharp and soft · focus and blur
框架构图 → framing composition / frame-in-frame
scenes.speak: For window shadows, seek reflections — blend sharp and soft. For layering, use framing composition. Doorways and window frames are natural picture frames.

scenes.context: 串一遍六个口诀：一特写、二对角线、多侧面、故事剪影、窗影反射、层次框架。记住这几个词，博物馆随便拍都有故事感。语域：摄影教学，总结收尾。
sentences: 一特写、二对角线、多侧面。
One: close-up; two: diagonal; many: the side view.
the side view（侧面）
故事剪影，窗影反射，层次框架。
Story: silhouette; window: reflection; layers: frames.
layers: frames（层次框架）
记住这六个口诀，随手拍都有故事感。
Remember these six rhymes and every casual shot has story feel.
casual shot（随手拍）
paraphrase: 口诀串讲 → run through the rhymes / recap the rules
随手拍 → casual shot / on-the-fly photo
scenes.speak: One: close-up; two: diagonal; many: the side view. Story: silhouette; window: reflection; layers: frames. Remember these six rhymes and every casual shot has story feel.

practice: Shoot one subject with a close-up, magnifying the detail.
Shoot several by circling to the side for oblique depth.
For story feel, use a silhouette with backlight.
One close-up, two diagonal, many side view; story silhouette, window reflection, layers frames.
pitfalls: Shoot one subject with a close-up.
Shoot two with a diagonal composition.
For story feel, use a silhouette with backlight.
Doorways and window frames are natural picture frames.
shifts: 拍一个只会 take a photo
用 close-up（特写）、diagonal composition（对角线）、oblique depth（斜纵深）
用 silhouette（剪影）、backlight（逆光）、outline stands out（轮廓突出）
用 framing（框架）、reflection（反射）、sharp and soft（虚实）
